To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the HARP front-end is feasible with the current CMOS technologies and that the performance of the front-end is sufficient to be used in a real-time read-out system.
The monolithic CMOS front-end electronics with analog pipelining is feasible and the key building blocks have been designed, simulated and tested.
We have designed a CMOS front-end electronics chip with an analog pipeline and a 12-bit ADC, which has the potential to be used as a building block in a HARP system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing the basic building blocks and the architecture for a CMOS monolithic front-end readout processor with pipelining for the HARP detector.
the design of monolithic integrated circuits which can perform the basic signal processing functions of an image processor.
the development and testing of monolithic analog and analog/digital CMOS front-end electronics for the HARP detector.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the design of the front-end electronics has been successfully completed.
the design of the front-end electronics is well under control, and that the design is progressing well.
the monolithic CMOS front end electronics is feasible.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the HARP architecture is a viable approach to the development of a high speed, high precision, high dynamic range analog signal processor.
all the functional blocks for the HARP front-end processor have been designed and the performance is in the range of the specifications.
all the basic functional blocks for HARP have been designed in 3 pn CMOs and 1.5 pm CMOS and tested.
The main takeaway from our work is that

it is possible to build a monolithic front-end electronics for the HARP detector with a power consumption of 1 W and an area of 1 cm2, which is a factor of 10 less power and 100 times less area than the existing solution.
the HARP front-end is feasible with CMOS technology.
the design of the analog front end is feasible in CMOS technologies.
